_comment: Maps each Terraform resource type to the noun used in its Jamf Protect audit-log op names (createPlan/updatePlan/deletePlan -> Plan). Audit entries key only on resourceId, which is unique within a type but NOT across types — small numeric ids collide between plans, roles, action configs and so on — so attribution must match resourceId AND the op noun. This is an ALLOWLIST: a queried type absent from this map is deliberately left unattributed (a dash in the report) rather than matched on resourceId alone, which would confidently mis-attribute it to a same-id event of a different type. The nouns are server-side audit vocabulary and are NOT derivable from the type name (custom_prevent_list -> PreventList, telemetry -> TelemetryV2, removable_storage_control_set -> USBControlSet, action_configuration -> ActionConfigs), so confirm any new noun against live data with `jamf-cli protect audit-logs list` before adding it. The entries below were verified against a live tenant and cover every type in reconcile.tfquery.hcl.
